Technology stocks were higher in recent trading, with the shares of tech companies in the S&P 500 adding nearly 0.6% in value, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was racing 5.2% higher.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Lam Research ( LRCX ) climbed as much as 16% on Thursday after the semiconductor processing equipment company reported fiscal Q2 net income and revenue topping analyst projections. It also authorized a new $5 billion stock buyback program.
In other sector news:
(+) Xilinx ( XLNX ) soared Thursday, rising 16% in recent trading, after the specialty chipmaker saw its non-GAAP Q3 net income grow to $0.92 per share from $0.65 per share during the same quarter last year, easily topping the Capital IQ consensus by $0.06 per share.
(-) Citrix Systems ( CTXS ) retreated during Thursday trading, falling almost 7%, after the cloud-based virtualization company issued Q1 and FY19 profit projections trailing analyst forecasts. It sees net income for the current quarter ending March in a range of $1.15 to $1.20 per share on between $700 million to $710 million in revenue. The Street is at $1.37 per share and $726.6 million, respectively.
